summary: Delivery app with Admin Panel, Home Page features (Wallet, Search, My Orders), and critical admin security fixes. Admin panel requires forced session checks, password protection, session lock, and no-bypass rule for all admin pages including Settings and QR.
architectural_notes: Admin Panel must enforce session authentication on every page load; unauthenticated users are redirected to /login
All admin routes including /admin, Settings, and QR pages are behind password protection with no public bypass
Session lock implemented with optional 'Remember Me' cookie; browser refresh or reopen requires re-authentication without valid cookie
known_issues: Admin Panel was accessible without a password — critical security vulnerability requiring immediate fix

existing_features.title: Rewrite the AdminGuard component so that on every page load (including refresh and browser reopen) it synchronously checks for a valid admin session in localStorage before rendering any admin content. If no valid session exists, immediately redirect to /login. The session must have a timestamp-based expiry (24 hours by default). Remove any logic that allows bypassing the session check.

Re-enable the hardcoded password check on the admin login page. The login form must validate the entered password against the stored admin credential before creating a session. If the password is incorrect, show an error message and do not create a session. Do not allow the admin panel to be accessed without successful password entry.

Implement a 'Remember Me' checkbox on the admin login page. When checked, persist the session in localStorage with a 7-day expiry (instead of session-only). When unchecked, clear the session on browser close by using sessionStorage so that reopening the browser requires re-authentication. If 'Remember Me' is not checked, the session must not survive a browser restart.

Wrap ALL admin routes — including /admin, /admin/settings, /admin/qr, /admin/billing, and any other /admin/* sub-routes — with the AdminGuard component so that none of them are publicly accessible. No admin page or sub-page should render any content before the session check passes.

new_feature_requests.summary: Activate Home Page features: functional Wallet with balance and transaction history, connected Search bar, My Orders with order tracking, replace 'Coming Soon' with 'No Data Found'
Critical security fix: force session check on every Admin Panel page load, re-enable password protection, session lock with Remember Me cookie, no-bypass for Settings and QR pages
